subject: ClearShore renewal renegotiation — discount & credit safeguard
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearshore.com>, Kevin Tan <kevin.tan@clearshore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation & capacity plan (clearshore)

Hi Maria / Kevin —

Hope you're both well. Our contract with ClearShore is coming up for renewal at the end of June and I wanted to start the pricing conversation early so we can avoid any last-minute churn on capacity. A few context bullets:  
- Q1 usage shows a 2.3x month-over-month increase driven by the Search assistant; projected run-rate suggests you’ll need ~1.5M extra tokens/month by Q3 if growth continues.
- Current term: 12-month, 500k committed tokens/month.

Quick ask: are you open to a 12–18 month renewal with a moderate commit increase? If so, we can propose a structure that combines a small committed uplift + a price-hold window and an operational credit to smooth the first two quarters of the uplift.

I’ve attached a draft termsheet with one path (conservative uplift) and an alternate with a larger commit + deeper discount — happy to walk through. If it helps, I can schedule a 30-min alignment call next week with Ben (pricing) and Grace (CS).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ClearShore_Renewal_Termsheet_v3.pdf (draft, redlines welcome)

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearshore.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Tan <kevin.tan@clearshore.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation & capacity plan (clearshore)

Kimberly — thanks for the heads up and for the clear summary. Apologies for the delay, we've been pulling usage reports for procurement. A couple of items from our side:  

- We are interested in a renewal but need a price hold for 90 days from signature while our Q3 budgeting locks down.
- We will consider a commit increase but require a $150k operational credit applied across Q1–Q2 of the renewed term to offset migration and model validation costs.
- Any discount needs to be at least 7% off current published tier for the uplifted volume, otherwise we’ll prefer to remain pay-as-you-go for overflow.

I’ve attached our Q1 usage export for reference. Also, procurement will want a simple way to review the final term (DocuSign tends to be fastest).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a 90-day price hold + the credit? If so, we’ll route to contracts@clearshore.com to begin internal approval.

- Maria
Director, Platform Ops | ClearShore
maria.lopez@clearshore.com

Attachments: Usage_Q1_2027.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearShore renewal — ask summary (internal)

Ben / Grace — forwarding Maria's note. Key asks: 90-day price hold, $150k operational credit across first two quarters, >=7% discount on uplifted volume.

Proposed internal play:  
- Offer path A: 12-month renewal, 20% commit uplift, 8% discount on committed blended consumption, $150k credit applied as invoice reduction split across Q1/Q2. 90-day price hold on list price for the committed tiers.  
- Offer path B (less aggressive): 12-month renewal, 10% commit uplift, 6% discount, $75k credit, 60-day price hold.

Notes / constraints:  
- We should be able to fund $150k credit for strategic customers, but need Ben/Finance sign-off on recognising credit as amortized revenue impact. Confirm whether this requires leadership approval or if you can sign within the quota.
- Grace — we’ll need a tight onboarding plan for the extra capacity (model validation runbook + smoke tests) so the credit ties to activation milestones. Can you outline two milestone checks?

Can you both weigh in by EOD tomorrow? I want to send a clean counter to Maria by Wednesday.

Thanks —
Kimberly

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearshore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation & capacity plan (clearshore) — proposed counter

Maria — thanks for the clear asks and the usage export; that was helpful. After an internal run, here’s the counter we can commit to without escalating to execs:  

Summary (commercial):
- Term: 12 months starting on signature.
- Commit: 20% uplift to your current committed tokens/month (numbers within the attached termsheet).
- Discount: 8% off our published committed-tier price for the uplifted volume (applies to committed tier consumption only).
- Credit: $150,000 operational credit applied as invoice credits split over the first two billing cycles of the renewed term (Q1 & Q2 equivalent).
- Price hold: 90-day price hold on list price for committed tiers (price changes outside the committed tier will not affect agreed rate during hold).
- Milestones: Activation checklist (1) validation run complete (smoke tests pass), (2) KV-cache warm-up + prefix-caching confirmed — both required within 45 days of signature for credit to apply.

Attached: updated termsheet (ClearShore_Renewal_Termsheet_v3.pdf) with redlines implementing the above. If this looks acceptable, I’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope and route to contracts@clearshore.com.

Small operational notes:
- Ben has approved the credit treatment and finance will amortize the credit against revenue; no VP sign-off required.
- Grace will lead the onboarding milestones and has a playbook ready to go for the smoke tests; she’ll coordinate the activation timeline once signed.

If you’re OK with the package I’ll: (a) upload the termsheet to DocuSign and (b) share the PO/DocuSign link with your procurement contact. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk the milestones.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearShore_Renewal_Termsheet_v3.pdf

Kimberly / Ben / Grace —

Thanks — the package looks reasonable. We are prepared to move forward with the path you outlined (12-month, 20% uplift, 8% discount, $150k credit, 90-day price hold) pending a final DocuSign. Please send the envelope to contracts@clearshore.com and I’ll route to our Procurement lead (cc'd).

A couple of admin notes from procurement:  
- We will issue a single PO referencing the DocuSign agreement.
- Please confirm the invoicing cadence (monthly) and that the $150k credit will appear as a line-item reduction across the first two invoices.

Once we have the DocuSign link we’ll start internal approvals. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Maria
